rationale: Job's oath rejects rejoicing because much wealth came to him; the instruction to the rich warns against arrogance and resting hope in uncertain wealth. The comparison concerns the attitude toward riches, not a denial of all enjoyment.

Elihu uses fermenting wine in a tied wineskin as an image of his pressure to speak; Jesus' saying describes new wine bursting old wineskins. The different uses and the additional bellows image are retained.
